correction_plan.title: 🔥 Step-by-step Correction Plan
correction_plan.description: Detailed action plan for parents and specialists to support the child's development. Each step includes recommendations and actions to help the child progress.

steps.heading: 📝 Step 1: Diagnosis and Assessment
steps.text: Conduct a comprehensive assessment: speech therapist, neuropsychologist, special education teacher. Identify strengths, weaknesses, problems, and needs of the child.

steps.heading: 📊 Step 2: Individual Plan Development
steps.text: Based on the assessment, specialists create an individual correction plan: goals, objectives, exercises, and schedule of sessions.

steps.heading: 🏃‍♂️ Step 3: Starting Correction Sessions
steps.text: Regular sessions with a speech therapist, psychologist, and adaptive physical education instructor. Includes exercises for speech, cognitive and motor skills, and emotional regulation.

steps.heading: 🏠 Step 4: Home Support
steps.text: Follow recommendations and exercises at home. Parents participate, track progress, and help reinforce skills.

steps.heading: 📈 Step 5: Monitoring and Adjustment
steps.text: Regularly evaluate the child's progress and adjust the plan as needed.

steps.heading: 🌍 Step 6: Integration into Society
steps.text: Gradual inclusion of the child in educational and social activities. Development of communication and independence skills.

steps.heading: 🤝 Step 7: Support for Specialists and Parents
steps.text: Regular consultations with specialists, sharing experience with other parents. Ensuring ongoing support at all stages.

disability.heading: 📄 How to apply for disability
disability.text: To apply for disability, you need to get a referral from a clinic, pass the MSE commission. Documents: certificates from specialists, medical record, parent's application. Contact the local social protection department or CSC.

benefits.heading: 💰 Benefits and payments
benefits.text: Parents of children with disabilities have access to monthly care benefits, tax benefits, and compensation for technical rehabilitation aids.

education.heading: 🎓 Education for children with disabilities
education.text: Inclusive classes, specialized schools, home and online learning are available. Registration through PMPK.

aromaloto.title: Aromoloto
aromaloto.description:
Aromaloto is designed for children and the whole family.

Aromaloto is the only game that develops the sense of smell. It develops all types of memory: visual, motor, figurative, and olfactory. Creates new neural connections. Made from safe natural materials.
A board game for any age, from 2 years old.

1. Development of smell: Playing aromatic lotto helps develop children's sense of smell and learn to recognize various scents.

2. Improvement of memory and attention: Children must remember and associate scents with specific objects or products, which contributes to the development of memory and attention.

3. Exciting pastime: Playing aromatic lotto can be an exciting and interesting activity for children, especially if played with family or friends.

4. Development of social skills: Playing aromatic lotto can contribute to the development of children's communication skills, as they can discuss and communicate delicately with each other.

5. Learning new knowledge: Playing aromatic lotto can be not only exciting but also educational, as children can learn about various scents and products.

Thus, aromaloto for children can be a useful and developmental activity that combines learning, fun, and the development of the sense of smell.

Aromatic lotto is a game aimed at improving sensory integration. It develops smell, memory, attentiveness, logic, spatial orientation, and perseverance.

GAME VARIANTS:

1. Guess the scent: Participants must try to guess the scents and place the jar on the corresponding field.

2. Scent recognition competition: Participants must take turns trying to guess the scents extracted from the aromaloto.

"Aromatic Memory" Game: Participants must remember the scents they smell from the aromaloto, and then arrange the cards of these scents.

3. Creating scent blends: Participants can try creating their own unique aromatic blends using aromaloto and various essential oils.

4. Aromatic lottery: Participants can play a lottery where they have to guess scents to win prizes.

5. Scent hunt: Participants can organize competitions to find specific scents hidden in different places, using aromaloto for clues.

6. "Aromatic Memory" Game: Participants must remember the scents they smell from the aromaloto, and then guess them after the aromaloto is closed.

soundloto.title: Soundloto
soundloto.description:
The game "Soundloto" is an exciting game that helps develop not only auditory perception but also to learn new sounds. I also combined such games as "FLAGOMANIA", "GUESS THE MELODY" and GREAT WORLD AND KAZAKH COMPOSERS into one big game SOUNDLOTO.

This game features 12 categories, a player with 195 interesting sounds, 12 fields, 140 cards in two languages, and chips.
+ educational songs, such as:

 LOGORHYTHMICS — is a technique where speech, music, and movements are combined into game exercises.
It develops the child's speech, hearing, rhythm, coordination, memory, and emotional expressiveness.

TONGUE TWISTERS — are short rhythmic phrases or syllable combinations that help children train clear pronunciation of sounds and syllables, develop diction, hearing, and a sense of rhythm.

AUDIO FAIRY TALES in two languages — are fairy tales in audio format that a child listens to instead of reading.
They help:
 • develop auditory attention and imagination,
 • enrich vocabulary,
 • train memory,
 • form skills of speech perception by ear,
 • soothe and set up for sleep.

AND EDUCATIONAL SONGS in Russian and Kazakh.

Choosing a category from the list, and there are 12 of them:
household sounds 
wild animals 
domestic animals 
great world and Kazakh composers 
musical instruments 
cartoons 
nature 
birds 
transport 
movies 
emotions 
languages 
your child learns and develops auditory perception, memory, and speech.

It is convenient to play with it everywhere: on the road, at home, visiting, on a train, or on a plane.

Sound Lotto is a cool tool for any specialist working with children.
